title: Registry triage after a ransomware infection with Registry Explorer and RECmd
summary: A lab method for reading Windows registry hives: persistence, defense evasion, and what actually ran. Registry Explorer bookmarks, ShimCache, BAM, UserAssist, RunMRU, ransomware-specific keys, and RECmd batch triage.

title: Detecting failed logons: reading Event 4625 from a real lab
summary: Reproduce failed logons in a lab, read every field of Event 4625, decode Status and SubStatus, triage an exported .evtx with a script, cross-check with SANS DeepBlueCLI, and tell a typo from brute force or password spraying with Splunk, KQL and Falcon queries.

title: Hunting PowerShell downloads in CrowdStrike and Splunk
summary: Find the file name, hash and source URL behind a PowerShell download using Falcon event_simpleNames (ProcessRollup2, NewExecutableWritten, DnsRequest, NetworkConnectIP4), then confirm and scope with Splunk proxy, firewall and DNS queries.

title: Network traffic hunting with JA3 and JA4 TLS fingerprints
summary: What a TLS fingerprint is, how JA4 differs from JA3, and Splunk queries to stack fingerprints, find new and rare clients, pivot to hosts and IPs, and spot beaconing.

title: DFIR case study: ClickFix and CrowdStrike hunting
summary: Lab investigation of a ClickFix (fake CAPTCHA, Win+R paste) intrusion with host artifacts, a timeline and nine CrowdStrike Falcon Advanced Event Search queries for hunting and scoping.

title: Hunting distributed web attacks with JA4 fingerprints
summary: How to use JA4 TLS fingerprints to cluster a distributed attack that rotates IPs and User-Agents, with Splunk and KQL hunting queries, corroboration with JA4H, mitigation and limits.

title: DFIR case study: phishing to lateral movement
summary: Lab-based investigation write-up: macro phishing, PowerShell execution, scheduled-task persistence, LSASS access and SMB lateral movement, with timeline, ATT&CK mapping and detections.
